item.title: All The Best Hair Looks from The BAFTAs 2026
item.description: Industry experts weigh in on their favourite hair looks from the BAFTAs 2026...

item.title: London Fashion Week AW26 Hair Trends
item.description: If SS26 was about polish and playfulness, AW26 turns inward – embracing narrative, contrast and character-led styling. This season, hair became an extension of storytelling on the runway, reflecting themes of travel, heritage, control, rebellion and romanticism.

item.title: Government Policy is Pricing Young People out of Hair and Beauty Apprenticeships
item.description: The NHBF is calling on Government to reduce rising employment costs preventing hair businesses from hiring apprentices.

item.title: Give Your Clients the Ultimate Backwash, Cut and Colour Experience
item.description: Discover how you can upgrade essential salon equipment affordably to give your clients the ultimate backwash, cut and colour experience.

item.title: Mentored by Lisa Farrall Launches to Empower the Next Generation
item.description: Award-winning hairdresser and educator Lisa Farrall has announced the launch of Mentored by Lisa Farrall – find out more.

item.title: Pride Flag Stolen for Sixth Time from Inclusive Leicester Salon
item.description: The owners of The Secret Garden Salon in Leicester have spoken out after their Pride flag was stolen for the sixth time, in what they describe as a targeted act of vandalism.

item.title: Murdock London Marks 20 Years with New Broadgate Central Barbershop
item.description: Award-winning barbershop Murdock London has continued to expand by opening a new location at Broadgate Central – and this is your chance to take a peek inside.

item.title: JOICO Color Talent Awards 2025 Winner Announced
item.description: The JOICO Color Talent Awards recognise and reward exceptional colour talent in the hairdressing industry – and you can check out the latest winners here.

item.title: Tressly Studios: London’s First Dedicated Textured Hair Co-Working Salon
item.description: Tressly Studios, London's first co-working salon designed exclusively for Afro, curly and coily hair, is opening in Lewisham.

item.title: Tom Chapman Recognised as One of the UK’s 100 Champions for Men and Boys
item.description: Tom Chapman Hon LLD, founder of HereToTalk and the Lions Barber Collective, has been recognised as one of the 100 Champions for Men and Boys in the UK by the Centre for Policy Research for Men and Boys.
